description: VOIDS (cancels) a payment that has been authorized but not yet captured — this releases the hold on the customer's funds. Checkout.com: POST /payments/{id}/voids.

id.description: Payment id to void, e.g. 'pay_...'. Required.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key — sent as the Cko-Idempotency-Key header.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata to attach to the void.

name: checkout_void_payment
title: Void payment
